persistent.guarantee: hook-result-only; no runtime claim of true disk durability

durable.guarantee: fail-closed crash-safe committed state after storage barrier; backend not yet implemented

traits.name: Persistable
traits.rule: compiler-generated versioned AOT codec; reject raw pointers, sockets, loans and unsupported graphs

invariants.actorState: snapshot only reachable actor-owned Persistable graph at a safe boundary; sealed state remains sealed
invariants.fencing: snapshot and receipts bind actor ID, epoch, sequence and schema/version; stale incarnation rejected
invariants.ordering: commits serialized per actor and monotonic; failed hook/IO does not acknowledge durable change
invariants.restore: recover verified state without repeating constructor side effects; corrupt state is an error, not empty state
invariants.durability: durable requires on-disk journaling and commit barrier, never silent in-memory downgrade
invariants.sideEffects: message replay can duplicate external side effects; exactly-once is not claimed

evidenceRule: Static contract tests do not prove Atto parser acceptance, compiled guest execution, disk fsync or crash recovery
